description: This is a Java configuration class for the LoRa adapter within an Eclipse Hono project. It defines Spring Boot configuration, bean creation, configuration properties exposure, cache management, and metrics customization specifically for the LoRa protocol adapter.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Spring Boot configuration class for the LoRa Protocol Adapter, enabling caching, defining bean components, configuration validation, and metrics setup.

methods.name: validateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates that the adapter's configuration requires authentication; throws an exception if not.

methods.name: loraProtocolAdapter
methods.description: Creates a new prototype scoped instance of the LoraProtocolAdapter.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamSenderFactoryConfig
methods.description: Sets a default name for the downstream sender if not provided.

methods.name: customizeRegistrationClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Sets a default name for the registration client if not provided.

methods.name: customizeCredentialsClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Sets a default name for the credentials client if not provided.

methods.name: customizeTenantClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Sets a default name for the tenant client if not provided.

methods.name: adapterProperties
methods.description: Provides the LoraProtocolAdapterProperties bean configured with the prefix 'hono.lora'.

methods.name: serviceFactory
methods.description: Creates an ObjectFactoryCreatingFactoryBean to produce instances of the LoraProtocolAdapter.

methods.name: cacheManager
methods.description: Provides a cache manager bean based on ConcurrentMapCacheManager.

methods.name: commonTags
methods.description: Configures metrics registry with common tags for the protocol adapter.
